recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the missing documentation requested by FHIR-22824 while preserving the already-applied score choice set and leaving separate extension/backport questions such as FHIR-28077 for their own reconciliation.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive CQI change request to add dateTime, CodeableConcept, Period, Range, and Duration as MeasureReport measureScore value types for system-health metric use cases, promote the CQF aggregateMethod extension to a Measure element, and document that continuous-variable measureScore type is determined by the aggregate method operation result type.
initial_application: Commit ee73226e8c (J#22824) converted both group and stratum measureScore elements to choice elements and added dateTime, CodeableConcept, Period, Range, and Duration. Commit 2ddef90c0a (J#28936) added Measure.group.population.aggregateMethod as a first-class element, covering the extension-promotion portion of the resolution.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini keeps Measure and MeasureReport active in the build. Later MeasureReport changes added boolean and Ratio score choices without conflicting with the FHIR-22824 choices. FHIR-41272 added broader quality-reporting scoring guidance, but current text still lacked the specific continuous-variable score type clarification. Zulip context confirmed FHIR-22824 as the R5 path for non-Quantity score types, and no conflicting Confluence or Zulip guidance was found.
reconciliation: Added comments to both MeasureReport measureScore[x] definitions and updated the continuous-variable-measures narrative to state that the reported measureScore[x] type is the result type produced by applying aggregateMethod to the individual Measure Observation results.
